name: promise-tracker
description: Finds what YOU committed to in your own sent email and chat over the last 7 days (up to 14 if you ask): "I'll send it Friday", "let me check and get back to you". It checks each one against your later messages and lists the ones still open, with who it was to, the due date, how many days overdue, and a link to the message; anything it can't back with a message you sent is left out. On request it drafts a reply that closes a commitment, on the same channel and thread, and sends it only after you approve that exact text, one draft at a time. It refuses rather than guessing when your mail and chat are not connected. Not other people's promises to you, and not a task manager or calendar.

skills.name: Open commitments
skills.description: Your own promises from your sent email and chat in the last 7-14 days that are still open: who, what, due date, days overdue, source link. Then a drafted reply per promise, sent only after you approve the exact text.
examples: What did I promise people in the last week and not deliver yet?
Anything I committed to in the last 14 days that's overdue?
#2, draft it: say it slipped and I'll have it Monday.
